feature_name: Secret Manager integration for transfer job source credentials
summary: Storage Transfer Service adds Preview support for using Secret Manager secrets when creating transfer jobs from AWS S3 or Azure Storage.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service adds Preview support for using Secret Manager secrets when creating transfer jobs from AWS S3 or Azure Storage.
